Assert equality against the durable read, never against a literal: a literal is a fixed point and a hardcoded-return mutant passes it.

(1) ROSTER + LAYER — the refusal roster and the fact roster are frozen and EXACT. `CUTOVER_GENERATION_FACTS` is asserted to have exactly FOUR members and to equal the four key names by set comparison, not `length > 0`: the drift marker this feeds reads four keys, and a snapshot naming three would satisfy a lower bound while leaving one generation uncompared forever.
(2) FOUR ABSENCE ARMS, ONE PER GENERATION, each pinning three things — `missing` (WHICH fact), the exact stable code, and the refusing layer. Four separate arms, not one parameterised "it refused": a single arm cannot tell you the reader names the RIGHT fact, and naming the wrong one sends an operator to the wrong evidence.

(5) THE CANONICAL-DIGEST ARM writes the evidence artifact PRETTY-PRINTED, exactly as the live lane does, so a reader that hashed the file bytes instead of deriving the canonical digest cannot pass. It also asserts a PRECONDITION — that `deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest(EVIDENCE)` is `ok` — so an invalid fixture reads as a fixture problem rather than being mistaken for the reader refusing.
